The '''Aida sector''' was located in the eastern portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It was bordered clockwise from the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] south by the [[Noolian sector/Legends|Noolian]], [[Maerdocian sector/Legends|Maerdocian]], and [[Daalang sector/Legends|Daalang sectors]], and by [[Lannik Space/Legends|Lannik Space]].<ref name="EA SMR">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-sectors-of-the-mid-rim|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim}}</ref> The [[Sector/Legends|sector]] contained the [[Aida system/Legends|Aida system]] and the [[Lomabu system/Legends|Lomabu system]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Aida system was sparsely settled but solidly pro-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], with [[Io Desnand]] serving as its Imperial [[Governor/Legends|Governor]]. The Lomabu system, home to six [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] bodies, contained the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Lomabuan]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The Lomabuans were found to be seditious against the Empire, and the entire planet was depopulated. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Governor Desnand set up a prison complex on [[Lomabu III]] and imprisoned hundred of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] there. Desnand planned to lure members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] to the planet to rescue the Wookiees, at which point Desnand would spring a trap. His plans never came to fruition as the Wookiee [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Chenlambec]] [[Mission to Lomabu III|freed]] the Wookiees and implicated [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] hunter [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] in pelt baiting.<ref name="Pelt" />
